headline: Samsung estimates a record quarterly profit of about $80 billion as AI memory demand surges.
score_reason: Major company estimate with a clear AI link; pool score 9 kept, the figure is an estimate so no rise or cut beyond the hedge.
importance_line: It matters most to investors and to buyers of memory chips, since tight supply is pushing their prices up, but the figure is a company estimate and full results only come on 29 October.
summary: Our 5 Oct edition carried a Korea Herald report that brokers expected Samsung, the South Korean memory chipmaker, to post a third-quarter operating profit of about 108.1 trillion won. Now Euronews reports Samsung's own estimate of 107.4 trillion won, or about $80.2 billion, which if confirmed would be the biggest quarterly operating profit ever reported by a technology company, beating the $63.7 billion Nvidia booked in its latest quarter.
notes: Credit chain: Reuters first wire (page blocked, 401) and CNBC (403) were not readable; the figures are read on Euronews. Euronews itself hedges the figure as an estimate.
